tagline: [WonderLaunch ](https://wonderlaunch.app)is like a launchpad plus a long-term product directory
description: [WonderLaunch ](https://wonderlaunch.app)is like a launchpad plus a long-term product directory. A founder submits a product, the product enters moderation, and once approved it gets assigned a launch date. Before launch day, the product page acts as a pre-launch countdown page where visitors can learn what is coming, subscribe for launch updates, and share the page. When the countdown ends, the same URL transforms into the live product page with upvotes, comments, product details, screenshots,
